raw_response: {"diagnosis": "60 of 200 raw_customers rows carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names, so they land as separate regions in silver_customers and gold_region_daily. raw_region_map is a clean 1:1 lookup from these codes to the four expected region names, so the correct values can be derived.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(COALESCE(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = trim(m.region_code)"}}
